rules: week: Mon/Tue extreme, Thursday expansion day making the opposite Mon..Thu extreme
weekly objective: Mon..Thu low <= previous week's low (bearish week; mirrored)
Friday: 1h sweep of Thursday's low (bearish week) then first 1h close back above -> long next M1 open; stop at sweep low; target week low + 0.25 x range; exit Fri 17:00 NY

params.thursday_expansion: Thu expansion day making Mon..Thu extreme
params.expansion_day: close beyond open AND beyond prior day extreme
params.friday_entry: first 1h close back inside Thu low/high after sweep
params.objective: previous week's low (bearish week) / high reached Mon..Thu
